Here is a doodle link for possible meeting times for the R group.  These are weekly times (even though I have only given one week of dates).

https://doodle.com/poll/caqmwn3xe5pwsdh9?utm_source=poll&utm_medium=link

We will meet through Zoom as that seemed to work fairly well last fall and involve 90% fewer parking difficulties.

    --Russell

messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] Starting up for Fall 2021
messages.body_plain:
It looks like the R User group will meet Weds at 2:00 on Zoom using the following Zoom link:

https://fsu.zoom.us/j/99423948380

At the first meeting, we will talk about (a) Scheduling Topics for the rest of the semester

and (2) using the DiagrammeR package and graphviz to draw diagrams.

    --Russell
